channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Paul Westphal | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Paul Westphal from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Monty Williams on Paul Westphal
item.description:
Suns coach Monty Williams on the late Paul Westphal:

“My experience with him was limited, I heard way more about him than I experienced, but the time I had with him was really cool. ...I've watched him treat people with a great deal of care and he just valued people.”

Monty Williams on Paul Westphal, Jan 3, 2021. Source: Twitter @AndrewGreif.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Paul Westphal
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Steve Kerr on the passing of Paul Westphal, who coached Kerr during Kerr's rookie season in Phoenix:

“It's a very sad day.... He was a really important figure early in my career.”

Steve Kerr on Paul Westphal, Jan 2, 2021. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Joe Maloof on Paul Westphal
item.description:
Maloof told CBSSports.com by phone.

“Paul Westphal is the coach and Geoff is our general manager. That’s the way it is and that’s the way it’s going to stay.”

Joe Maloof on Paul Westphal, Dec 24, 2010. Source: CBSSports.com.
